rationale: Explicit user authorization covers the initial read-only release change-scope and commit-provenance audit. Inspect the current branch, staged and unstaged names, untracked names, diff/stat provenance, and ownership boundaries; do not stage, commit, modify, clean, push, deploy, read secrets, or alter generated files. The audit must classify every candidate change as in-scope, pending-owner, or excluded and report whether a clean/safe release commit can later be assembled. External mutations remain blocked pending all release gates.
